HOW TO USE:
Copy this file to your project's include path.
Rename the copy to "syn_config.h".
Edit the copy to enable/disable modules and set buffer sizes.
SyntropicOS headers look for "syn_config.h" on the include path. If the file is not found, sensible defaults are used.
